class.name: IfcUShapeProfileDef
class.brief_description: IfcUShapeProfileDef defines a section profile that provides the defining parameters of a U-shape (channel) section to be used by the swept area solid. Its parameters and orientation relative to the position coordinate system are according to the following illustration. The centre of the position coordinate system is in the profile's centre of the bounding box. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x2. IFC2x3

members.member: Web lengths, see illustration above (= h). A float, or null when unset.
Flange lengths, see illustration above (= b). A float, or null when unset.
Constant wall thickness of web (= ts). A float, or null when unset.
Constant wall thickness of flange (= tg). A float, or null when unset.
Fillet radius according the above illustration (= r1). A float, or null when unset.
Edge radius according the above illustration (= r2). A float, or null when unset.
Slope of flange of the profile. A float, or null when unset.
A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
